item.title: Bill would eliminate statute of limitations for sex abuse civil suits
item.description: The Missouri Senate is considering a bill that will remove the statute of limitations for survivors of sex assault.

item.title: Endangered Person Advisory canceled after 4-year-old girl was reported missing in Hickory County
item.description: HICKORY COUNTY, Mo. — Police in Hickory County issued an endangered person advisory on Friday, Feb. 20, after a 4-year-old girl was reportedly taken by force following an assault on her mother. The endangered person advisory has now been canceled. This article has been updated to protect the 4-year-old's privacy.

item.title: Cold air on full blast through the weekend
item.description: Cold winter weather has returned, with temperatures dropping 15-20 degrees from Thursday, and gusty winds driving wind chills into the teens and 20s, but warmer weather is expected to return by Tuesday with highs near 70.

item.title: Arc of the Ozarks expanding Autism Center to meet demand
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — In 2024, Arc of the Ozarks opened its Autism and Neurodevelopmental Center to address an ever-growing waitlist for families wanting evolutions and potential therapy. item.description: MARSHFIELD, Mo. — A Webster County woman says a Valentine’s Day walk to her mailbox ended with a violent arrest and a night in jail after a new neighbor accused her of trespassing. item.title: Missouri announces new fishing rule at Table Rock Lake
item.description: TABLE ROCK LAKE, Mo. — If you're fishing at Table Rock Lake this summer, you can now keep smaller spotted bass after new regulations were enacted by the Missouri Conservation Department. item.title: Springfield-Greene County Library staff uncovers new details in 1865 shootout
item.description: New evidence uncovered by the Springfield-Greene County Library District suggests that "Wild Bill" Hickok and Davis Tutt were closer than 75 yards apart during the 1865 Hickok-Tutt shootout, and that Hickok was in the southwest corner of the square, not the southeast.

item.title: Man in custody after reports of gunfire at Eustasis
item.description: Police responded to reports of a man with a gun and shots fired at a psychiatric and addiction health facility in Springfield, Mo. on Friday, but no one was injured and the shooter was taken into custody.
